purpose: Board token art for asset id art.token.party.brute.v1 (Brute bust, party plate); party side plate. Drawn by the classic renderer for combatants of this archetype. This is a REDO: the delivered asset replaces the current file one-for-one at promotion.
prompt: Pixel-art bust portrait token for a tabletop combat board: a hulking brute with a heavy jaw and a crude club, shoulders-up, facing the viewer, centred on a round cool blue plate with a darker rim, the plate resting on a soft circular dark drop shadow. Light from the top-left, flat stepped shading, crisp 1:1 pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no text. Fully transparent outside the plate and its shadow.
negativePrompt: photograph, 3D render, isometric perspective, blur, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, text, watermark, signature, border, frame

style.summary: Matches the repository's classic-board pixel art: 128 x 128 top-down tile, crisp 1:1 pixels, flat stepped shading with light from the top-left, shadows shifting toward blue-violet and lights toward yellow, the generated palette of eight hue ramps (stone, wood, earth, moss, cloth-warm, cloth-cool, metal, skin) plus cool-grey neutrals.
style.palette: Generated ramp palette, see src/assets/palette.ts; keep to the same hue families as the current asset.

background.notes: True alpha channel outside the subject and its circular drop shadow; drop-shadow alpha at or below 60 percent.

acceptanceCriteria: File is a PNG, exactly 128 x 128, 8-bit RGBA.
Composition, footprint and transparency class match the current token-party-brute-v1.png so the file is a drop-in replacement (same name at promotion).
Pixels are crisp: no anti-aliased edges, no smooth gradients; a 4x nearest-neighbour zoom shows only hard-edged pixels.
No text, signature, watermark, border or frame.
Plate colour family matches the current party plates (cool blue); the plate diameter and position match token-party-brute-v1.png within 4 px so tokens stay aligned on the board.
The subject is recognisable as the named archetype at 1:1 on a 128 px cell.
notes: Part of batch redo-starter-art-v1: a redo of every starter art asset. Recipe from src/assets/starter-art-inputs.ts: {"kind": "token", "material": "skin", "archetype": "brute", "side": "party"}.
